newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nordic Aluminium sets FIM 45-53 issue price range.
newsitem.headline: Nordic Aluminium sets FIM 45-53 issue price range.

text.p: Finnish aluminium profiles and components maker Nordic Aluminium said on Wednesday its initial public offering would be priced between 45 and 53 markka per share to the public, but institutional investors might pay more.
"Shares are offered to investors in a price range of 45-53 markka," it said in a statement.
The company's owners were offering three million shares, or 65.5 percent of the total, to institutional investors and the public.
"In the public offer, the top of the price range (53 markka per share) is the highest possible issue price," it said.
"The final issue price (to institutional investors) will be set based on institutional investors' subscriptions...and may be below or above the range," Nordic Aluminium said.
The offer to the public would start on April 10, not on April 9 as the company had announced earlier, it said, adding it expected the offer to the public to end on April 16.
The subscription price in the public offer would be fixed around April 17 based on the book-building period for the offer to institutional investors, the company said.
Lead manager Enskilda Securities has an over-allotment option for an additional 0.45 million shares, it said.
The company would also offer up to 41,600 shares to employees and 30,000 shares to board members at a subscription price 10 percent below the price of the public offer.
